acceptance.given: A Skill declares version-sensitive information and includes a source record for that information.

oracle.expected: The validator reports the package as valid with respect to the required source record when the record is present and readable.
forbidden: A missing or unresolved source record is accepted.
oracle.observable: Structured package-validation status and diagnostics from the real validator entry.

acceptance.then: The validator recognizes the source record as present; a missing or unresolved source record produces a typed package diagnostic.
acceptance.when: A test calls validate_package on a disposable package root using the declared policy and strict mode, then inspects structured status and diagnostics without performing a live lookup.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_capabilities.py::test_a14: exercise a version-sensitive Skill with its source record absent and assert the typed package diagnostic from the real validate_package entry.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that a version-sensitive Skill contains a readable source record and report a typed diagnostic when it is missing or unresolved.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted runtime state is changed; keep the declared contract and result schemas compatible with their frozen versioned forms.

slice_hint.state_transition: A version-sensitive Skill with an unconfirmed source record is evaluated; validation identifies the record as present or returns a typed missing/unresolved-record diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted A14 test and applicable predecessor checks pass, and the completed plan's terminal selection validates the required source-record behavior.
